Name: GNMTokens for Make Gunther Real
Author: EraTheOutworlder
Description:
This is a patch for [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/WerewolfMaster/]WerewolfMaster[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]Make Gunther Real [/url]Mod.
It's primary purpose is to change gendered dialogues to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens[/url].
Because it only patches the content of Make Gunther Real, it is recommended to also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod [/url]for the rest of the game's content.
(But if you're interested in this, I'd guess you already do, huh?)

It also contains some fixes and added responses to SDV 1.6 changes/additions that weren't covered by the official mod update.

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Gunther's marriage schedule will now return him to the farm instead of stopping at the bus stop.
[*]8 heart event will not play unless 4 and 6 heart events have been seen because dialogue assumes you have seen them (original mod description says it should only trigger after 6 and optionally 7 heart events, but it doesn't work this way. If that gets fixed, I'll remove this)
[*]Certain 1.6 items no longer show glitched reaction text when gifted
[*]Additions:
[*]Some divorce related content
[/list]
